title: acp.envelope metadata payload
description: Indexing metadata beside the envelope (ADR 0004). The canonical value of the fact is the complete raw NDJSON frame text bound as jsonb in the payload column itself; this schema therefore never validates the envelope, only the separate metadata payload carried beside it. Content equality is never a deduplication key: observation_id is the stable occurrence identity.

method.description: Method of the request/notification; null for responses.

correlated_method.description: For responses, the method of the correlated request.

rpc_id.description: JSON-RPC id as received (string or integer); null for notifications.

command_id.description: Dispatch this envelope belongs to (outbound prompts/cancels).

connection_id.description: Identity of the bridge connection the frame crossed.

observation_id.description: Stable occurrence identity; two identical envelopes are two distinct occurrences.

frame_size.description: UTF-8 byte size of the raw frame.
